main_text.l: Caab dicitur; vel [illegible, ~6 letters] Letac'ibeba, quod for-
mæ sit quadrata, à [illegible, ~3 letters] Quadratum facere. Vocant
etiam [illegible, ~4 letters] Albait-alharam, Domum inter-
dictam, i. e. sacram seu Asylum, [illegible,
~12 letters]i.e.Posuit Deus Caabam domum inter-
dictum. [illegible, ~6 letters] Alc. Surat. 5ta. imò & [illegible, ~6 letters] Adora-
torium sacrum, ut mox dicturi sumus. Ejus struen-
dæ rationem hanc affert Shareftanius (quem ut non
infimæ notæ Authorem in re de qua tam varia & in-
certa apud alios reperiantur, præeunte mendaciorum fon-
te Alcorano, non tamen ut hîc fide dignum laudamus)
quòd sc. Adamus Paradiso pulsus cum à Deo peteret ut
sibi domus ad similitudinem ejus quâ in cœlo viderat ( * [illegible,
~2 words] i.domum habitatâ, & [illegible, ~2 words] Alfareh,
quod excelsū denotat, vocant) struendæ copia conce-
deretur ad quam preces suas dirigeret, & quam cultûs
gratiâ circumiret, ut cœlestê illam Angeli & Spiritus
ambiunt, Deum lucis quasi aulæa formâ Domûs
demisisse, ad quam inter orandum faciem converteret,
cámque circumiret. Mortuo Adamo Sethum ipsius
filium, ejusdem formæ domum è lapidibus & luto
fabricâsse quam cùm dejecisset diluvii vis,
Abrahamum cum filio Ismaele, Dei mandato aliam ejus
loco & formâ condidisse, locum ejus Abrahamo mon-
stratum à [illegible, ~4 letters] i. e. [illegible, ~4 letters] refert Al Jannabius in
vit. Abrahami. Eandem cùm ad ruinam vergeret
ab aliis atque aliis subinde restitutam ac reno-
vatam, post Mohammedem natum à Koraishitis,
deinde ab Ebn Zobair, atque ea demum qua nunc
est forma ab Hejaz, anno Hejra 74. tradunt
Abul Feda, Author libri Mesalec, Jannabius
Ahmed Ebn Yusef, &c. Quo minùs ejus mutandæ
licentiam

marginalia.note: Quia reliqua in Mecca ædificia super-eminent[?] Amed, Ebn Yusef, in Mecca. v.Kam. &c. * Quanquā alii per Al-Bait almaamur ipsam Caabam quā Adami tepore[?] Deus è cælo demiserat, diluvii tempore iterū in cœlum receptam, atq; ibi servatā[?] intelligant. Zamach in Comm.[?] ad Alc. c. 2. Nugis hisce testimonium perhibet ipse Alc.dū[?] Caabam vocant اول بيت وضع للناس i. domū s[?]que posita est hominibus et ab Abraham. & Ismaele condita asse-rit. Alc.c. 2.

page.notes: Arabic script is largely illegible at this scan resolution; the Arabic phrases in brackets are marked where they could not be read letter by letter. "Caab" and "Letac'ibeba" are as printed; the word before "Albait-alharam" is Arabic and marked illegible. Some Arabic marked "[?]"-level readings were not attempted. The page ends mid-sentence at "licentiam"; the continuation is on the other part of the scan. The marginal column is set in small italic type with many abbreviations; words marked [?] are uncertain. The Arabic line (اول بيت وضع للناس) is copied as printed. The superscript after "domū s" is a small abbreviation mark I could not read with certainty.
